messages:
Sophia: Hey team — invoice INV-9382 from Vertex Cloud got auto-flagged for a sales-tax exemption claim. Vendor uploaded an image of a ‘Resale Certificate - CA’ but I can't find a signed PDF on the vendor record. link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-9382
Alejandra: I checked NetSuite and vendor portal. Portal has an upload but it's a photo (blurry). Can we ask for a signed PDF?
Raj: Quick Q — do we have economic nexus in CA for this product line? If we don't, CA sales tax shouldn't apply, but exemption still needs to be valid. @tim any nuance for GPU/infra vs SaaS? :thinking_face:
Tim: CA can tax certain digital/infra services in limited circumstances. Resale certs normally apply to tangible personal property; reseller status matters. Send me the uploaded image and I'll review.
Sophia: Invoice snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-9382
Date: 2025-11-06
Vendor: Vertex Cloud LLC (US)
Lines:
 - Dedicated GPU hours x 120 = $3,200.00
Tax: $0.00 (claimed exemption)
Total: $3,200.00
Note: 'Resale cert on file'
```
Alejandra: Manual hold placed on payment while we verify docs.
invoices-bot: Payment hold applied to INV-9382 by @alejandra — reason: tax-exemption verification required — hold_until: 2025-11-20.
Raj: If vendor can't produce a CA certificate that names Redwood Inference, Inc., we should treat tax as due. Do we have the CA BOE-compliant template to send?
Alejandra: Yes — legacy checklist in Confluence at /finance/tax/resale-cert-checklist. I'll request: 1) signed PDF, 2) purchaser exactly 'Redwood Inference, Inc.', 3) seller info completed, 4) effective date.
Sophia: Vendor also asked if we'd gross-up the invoice to cover possible tax exposures. What's AP policy?
Maria: @sophia we don't gross-up automatically. Gross-up requests require sales + legal sign-off and are uncommon. Prefer reissue with tax or valid exemption. I'll handle escalations.
Tim: If exemption claim is incorrect and tax is later assessed, recovery from vendor is possible but incurs delay. Holding payment is safest.
Alejandra: Sending vendor message now with CA template and clear instructions.
Alejandra: Message sent: "Hi — please re-upload a signed PDF of your CA resale certificate naming 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as purchaser. If you cannot provide that, do you expect Redwood to gross-up the invoice to cover CA sales tax? Note we cannot auto-gross-up without approvals."
Sophia: Dropping the uploaded photo here for @tim review.
Tim: Looks like a cellphone photo, missing signature and seller FEIN — not acceptable. :no_good:
Raj: OK — action items: Alejandra follows up in 48h, hold remains until 2025-11-20. If no valid doc, escalate to @maria for next steps (withhold tax, reissue, or gross-up rare exception).
Alejandra: Will update thread after vendor responds. cc @sophia @raj
Sophia: Thanks — marking this for AP queue. :white_check_mark:
